# LOCALinference.eu

> Independent guide to local AI on turnkey 128GB devices. What runs,
> how fast and what it costs. We do not run our own benchmarks; figures
> come from public sources with a date and configuration.

Language: English. Czech edition: https://www.localinference.cz

## Key pages

- https://www.localinference.eu/ — overview
- https://www.localinference.eu/devices/compare/ — 128GB device comparison
- https://www.localinference.eu/models/qwen3-8-flash-next/ — the model
- https://www.localinference.eu/generation/ — images, video, audio, 3D
- https://www.localinference.eu/generation/licensing/ — licenses
- https://www.localinference.eu/guides/ — first run
- https://www.localinference.eu/dictionary/ — terms
- https://www.localinference.eu/topics/ — topics
- https://www.localinference.eu/sources/measurements/ — measurements
- https://www.localinference.eu/sources/what-we-dont-know/ — gaps
- https://www.localinference.eu/sources/changelog/ — changelog

## Data

YAML data lives in the Czech source repository:
https://github.com/Staticke-weby/LOCALinference.cz

## Rules

- Turnkey devices with 128 GB or more unified memory only.
- Qwen3.8 Flash Next is the only model in the catalogue.
- No own benchmarks; every number has a source and a date.
- USD list prices; no retailer or affiliate links.
